_metadata.linkedin_india_cpc: No verified India-specific LinkedIn CPC found. Global average is $5.74 (~₹480). Manufacturing/BFSI LinkedIn CPC is a calibrated estimate, NOT researched.
_metadata.ctr_note: No India-specific CTR-by-industry source found. Values are estimated from platform-level benchmarks: Google Search India 4.5–7%; Meta India 1.5–2.5%; LinkedIn global 0.44–0.65%. Do not treat as verified market research.
_metadata.customer_spend_note: Spend ranges in customer_profiles_gen.py are modeled estimates. No publicly verified India-vertical-specific LTV dataset was found.
_metadata.attribution_note: Linear attribution_weight is a modeling choice for ML training neutrality, NOT an India market benchmark claim.

bfsi.ctr_source: unverified_estimate — blended from Meta India (~2%) and Google Search India (4.5–7%); BFSI skews search-heavy
bfsi.cpc_source: verified — nicodigital.com 2026, bucketed with education/B2B software/real estate
bfsi.conversion_rate_source: unverified_estimate — no India-specific BFSI conversion rate source found; 3–8% cited globally for optimised landing pages
bfsi.avg_conversion_value_source: unverified_estimate — modeled as credit card/loan lead early-life value
bfsi.compliance_notes: Never surface or amplify unverified financial advice or scam-adjacent content; flag anything resembling investment promises.

insurance.ctr_source: unverified_estimate — insurance is a saturated/low-CTR vertical; estimated from Meta India lower-band (~0.8–1.0%)
insurance.cpc_source: verified — nicodigital.com 2026, explicitly cited as most expensive alongside lending
insurance.conversion_rate_source: unverified_estimate — no India insurance-specific conversion rate source found
insurance.avg_conversion_value_source: unverified_estimate — modeled as first-year premium for a term/health policy
insurance.compliance_notes: Treat claims settlement sentiment carefully. Insurance is a regulated advice category; flag unverified policy advice.

rcg.ctr_source: unverified_estimate — fashion/ecommerce on Meta India typically 3–5%; conservative mid-band used
rcg.cpc_source: verified — nicodigital.com 2026, directly cited: 'fashion ecommerce ₹3... ecommerce/retail ₹3–25'
rcg.conversion_rate_source: unverified_estimate — India ecommerce conversion rate 1.8–3% (cited globally); 4.5% reflects high-intent festive campaigns
rcg.avg_conversion_value_source: unverified_estimate — above quick-commerce AOV (₹650–850); D2C AOV typically ₹1K–3K
rcg.compliance_notes: Flag any medical/health claims embedded in product reviews or influencer content.

travel.ctr_source: unverified_estimate — travel creatives are visually strong; estimated at upper band of Meta India (2.5–3.5%+)
travel.cpc_source: verified — nicodigital.com 2026, bucketed with 'home services, automotive, most retail'; often below ₹25 off-peak
travel.conversion_rate_source: unverified_estimate — no India travel-specific conversion rate sourced
travel.avg_conversion_value_source: unverified_estimate — modeled as domestic flight + hotel booking average
travel.compliance_notes: Factual safety-incident detection only; no speculation amplification. Lowest compliance risk of the 5 verticals.

healthcare.ctr_source: unverified_estimate — healthcare skews organic search; estimated at mid-band Google India (2–3%)
healthcare.cpc_source: verified — nicodigital.com 2026, bucketed with legal/professional services
healthcare.conversion_rate_source: unverified_estimate — no India healthcare-specific ad conversion rate sourced
healthcare.avg_conversion_value_source: unverified_estimate — modeled as OPD consultation + diagnostics package
healthcare.compliance_notes: Highest compliance bar — must flag unverified medical claims and misinformation; never amplify patient speculation.

manufacturing.ctr_source: partially_verified — LinkedIn sponsored content global average 0.44–0.65%; India not separately sourced; global used as proxy
manufacturing.cpc_source: unverified_estimate — no source names Manufacturing directly; extrapolated from B2B software tier (same long-cycle sales profile) per nicodigital.com 2026
manufacturing.conversion_rate_source: unverified_estimate — B2B manufacturing leads India: ₹800–5000/lead cited; conversion rate derived from CPL model
manufacturing.avg_conversion_value_source: unverified_estimate — modeled as MQL pipeline entry value for B2B manufacturing contract
manufacturing.compliance_notes: Exclusively B2B lead generation. Long sales cycles (3–12 months). Tied to fiscal year-ends and major trade show cycles.
